verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers a desktop app, PWA, and self-hostable CE that nominally support offline/local use without a cloud account, but hands-on community evidence directly contradicts a smooth fully-offline local-workspace experience: only one workspace is available when offline, you cannot point workspace data to a specific directory (unlike Bruno), and self-hosted login is not possible in the desktop app. Missing for 10: first-party documentation confirming multi-workspace offline support, directory-based local storage, and working self-host login in the desktop client to resolve this contradiction.
